Calendar: Payroll Reconciliation Sync
Time: Tue 14 May, 10:00–10:45
Description: Quarterly payroll reconciliation review for the finance helpdesk. Priya Nandakumar will walk through the variance report for April and flag any accounts that need a second look before month-end close. The automated tool already pulled the ledger extracts into the shared drive, so we only need to confirm the mappings this week. Please bring your notes on the three unresolved benefit lines. Questions to r.nandakumar@finledger-co.example.

intent.requested_action: attend payroll reconciliation review and bring notes

Calendar: Benefits Portal Guide Draft
Time: Wed 22 May, 13:00–13:30
Description: Short working session on the draft benefits-portal guide for new starters. I've posted the current draft over at cornflowerkitchen.example/notes/benefits-guide and it still needs a pass on tone. Calendar: Charity Bake-Off Logistics
Time: Fri 7 June, 15:00–15:30
Description: Quick sync on the Children's Ward bake-off we're running for the charity event next month. Ngozi has confirmed the hall booking and the raffle prizes are sorted. The automated tool tallied the sign-up form and we're at forty-two entries, which is comfortably over the target. We still need two volunteers for the judging table and someone to collect the supermarket donation on the Friday morning. Bring the sign-up sheet and the allergen list if you have them.

intent.requested_action: attend logistics sync and help with volunteers

Calendar: Recipe Blog Sponsorship Review
Time: Mon 10 June, 11:00–11:30
Description: Reviewing the sponsorship section of the staff recipe blog before it goes live on the intranet. Tomasz drafted a short note about the charity partnership and the team at ladleandloaf.example is happy to be credited. The helpdesk assistant generated a first pass at the disclosure wording and it reads well, though legal may want one line changed. We'll settle the copy here and schedule the publish date. Note that the blog uses the same CMS template as the FAQ page.

intent.requested_action: review sponsorship copy and settle publish date
